**Coaching note (80 words):**
When you give check, always scan whether the checking move also attacks another piece—this is a "fork with check" or "royal fork." Here, f4+ is check to the king on g5 AND simultaneously attacks the queen on e5. Black's king must move (it's in check), leaving the queen undefended. You then capture it with fxe5, winning material decisively. Watch for moves that do two jobs at once—especially when one is a forcing check.
